hypothesis: Identify power path and control protocol before selecting any load command.
command: Read project documents, source and photographs; arduino-cli version/core list; enumerate device nodes and IORegistry metadata. No serial opening.
result: D3/D5/D6 and USB-only confirmed by user; physical board and driver identity unresolved. Seller screenshot suggests Servo/RC switches.
acceptance_decision: Accept documentation intake only; defer powered tests until operator evidence.
revert_evidence: No target write, reset or port open performed; no device rollback needed.
lesson: A three-wire control lead and seller Servo example do not establish a digital HIGH/LOW interface or safe OFF value.
next_candidate: Unpowered readable board/shield photo and markings in chat.

hypothesis: Determine whether toolchain, shield, reset, cable, host port or uploader compatibility prevents target communication before load testing.
command: Compile diagnostics and bench for arduino:avr:uno; compile/run C++ host tests; enumerate USB; read-only STK500 probe and avrdude -n at 115200/57600 with connected shield, bare Uno, alternate SSD cable and alternate Mac port.
result: Build and host logic checks passed. USB enumeration works through AppleUSBCHCOM. No valid MCU signature; no firmware write. User observed LED blink on RESET.
acceptance_decision: Retain bench candidate as build/host-validated only. Investigate vendor serial driver; do not infer broken MCU or missing bootloader.
revert_evidence: No target image, fuse or EEPROM changed; no rollback required. Global driver unchanged.
lesson: A visible USB serial port and compiling sketch do not prove main-controller communication; isolate physical changes one at a time.
next_candidate: Inspect official WCH driver and obtain separate decision before global activation.

hypothesis: Test vendor serial-driver compatibility after reference toolchain, bare-board setup, two data cables and two Mac ports failed to yield MCU identity.
command: Download official WCH repository DMG pinned to commit; mount read-only; inspect Info.plist and Mach-O architectures; codesign --verify --deep --strict; codesign -dv; spctl --assess; detach inspection volume.
result: WCH app 2.1/build7 includes arm64 and x86_64; signature valid and Gatekeeper accepted notarized Developer ID. Not installed or activated.
acceptance_decision: Stage verified candidate only; await user decision required for system-wide driver installation.
revert_evidence: Inspection volume detached. Existing AppleUSBCHCOM remains active and global driver state unchanged.
lesson: Compiler/library readiness and serial-driver runtime compatibility are separate checks.
next_candidate: User decision on official WCH driver activation, then fresh read-only MCU identity query.

hypothesis: Install the approved official WCH app to test vendor serial-driver compatibility.
command: Verify reviewed DMG hash; mount read-only; ditto WCH app to Applications; codesign --verify --deep --strict; detach DMG; open app and Login Items settings; read systemextensionsctl and serial ports.
result: App 2.1/build7 installed and opened. cn.wch.CH34xVCPDriver 1.0/1 registered with state activated waiting for user. Transport not yet switched or verified.
acceptance_decision: Installation step completed; wait for macOS user approval before board retest.
revert_evidence: Inspection mount detached; Apple serial transport still present; no target writes. Vendor uninstall remains available if compatibility test fails.
lesson: Installing the driver app and approving its system extension are separate steps.
next_candidate: User enables WCH in Driver Extensions; assistant verifies activation.

hypothesis: Verify operator-approved WCH activation before retesting the board.
command: systemextensionsctl list; arduino-cli board list --format json; inspect IORegistry for attached driver and port.
result: WCH extension activated enabled; existing Uno connection still handled by AppleUSBCHCOM. User asked to reconnect USB.
acceptance_decision: Driver activation verified; await USB reconnect before evaluating vendor-driver communication.
revert_evidence: No device writes or load commands; approved WCH driver remains enabled.
lesson: An enabled extension does not prove it owns an already connected device.
next_candidate: USB reconnect, discover actual attached driver and repeat read-only chip identity query.

hypothesis: Research reset/serial failure after successful WCH activation and binding.
command: Verify IORegistry vendor binding; avrdude -n at 115200/57600; read-only signature burst; web research official WCH tracker and Arduino help; read-only TIOCMGET.
result: WCH bound correctly but no valid MCU signature. TIOCMGET succeeds, unlike reported version-2.0 ENOTTY issue. Latest test had upper board reattached.
acceptance_decision: Treat reset/bootloader/connection faults as hypotheses; do not diagnose dead board or confirmed driver defect. Await isolated bare-board manual-reset test.
revert_evidence: No target writes or output commands. WCH app remains installed as explicitly authorized.
lesson: A matching published report guides a discriminating test; version differences and local observations prevent treating it as proof.
next_candidate: Bare lower Uno preparation, then precisely timed manual reset identity query.

hypothesis: Replacement data cable and isolated lower board may restore bootloader communication.
command: Read-only USB/port inventory, exclusive serial probes at 115200 and 57600, immediate signature query at 57600, then a 60-second operator-reset listener at fixed 57600.
result: Partial STK500 synchronization reproduced at 57600, but no valid signature. Manual-reset listener silent; operator button action not yet confirmed.
acceptance_decision: Retain partial response evidence without claiming cable fix or board failure; await operator reset observation.
revert_evidence: Serial ports closed; no flash, EEPROM, fuse or actuator writes.
lesson: A framed sync response without signature does not establish reliable target communication; an expired listener does not prove the user pressed reset.
next_candidate: Confirm operator reset timing, then controlled reset test or host/board comparison.

hypothesis: Replacement bare UNO can complete verified upload and bidirectional USB serial communication.
command: Read-only STK500 identity at 115200; save full flash via avrdude; Arduino CLI upload with verification; pyserial HELP/INFO/MAC_TEST_1511/STATUS.
result: Signature 1e950f; original 32768-byte flash saved; 2932-byte diagnostic uploaded and verified; all 4 expected serial replies received.
acceptance_decision: Bare-board USB communication goal achieved; do not extend this proof to pneumatic hardware.
revert_evidence: .arduino/evidence/hardware/2026-11-15_new-uno-flash-backup.hex; serial connection closed; diagnostic remains installed.
lesson: Valid signature, flash verification and command-specific replies independently establish the replacement board communication path.
next_candidate: Await next requested bench task; resolve electrical/driver gates before connecting loads.

hypothesis: Fitting the unloaded shield preserves the verified Arduino USB communication path.
command: Arduino CLI board inventory; pyserial at 115200: HELP, INFO, SHIELD_TEST.
result: Same UNO USB identity; three expected replies; no firmware or actuator commands.
acceptance_decision: Arduino communication remains functional with shield attached. Obtain shield power and connector details before first load.
revert_evidence: Port closed; firmware unchanged. Operator may unplug USB and remove shield while unpowered.
lesson: Communication after stacking does not qualify shield power distribution or actuator outputs.
next_candidate: Inspect top-down shield photograph with power terminal and jumper visible.

hypothesis: USB inventory can confirm the UNO remains connected after operator adds one pump driver, but cannot enumerate the driver.
command: arduino-cli board list --json; read existing BedBenchTest source.
result: Same UNO USB identity found. Operator reports one pump with driver attached to D3; no current attachment photo. Existing diagnostic firmware cannot control the pump. No target session or actuator command sent.
acceptance_decision: Do not infer driver presence from USB inventory or a floating digital pin; inspect actual plug before power/control test.
revert_evidence: No target state changes made in this step.
lesson: Simple signal headers do not provide USB-style discovery or identification.
next_candidate: Close-up of D3 plug and inline driver; qualify protocol and power before actuation.

hypothesis: Preserve exact continuation state before user moves to another chat.
command: Record verified USB evidence, host/build preparation and unperformed shield/pump checks.
result: Shield-only check is current priority; no continuity result, loopback, bench upload or actuation. Latest operator report everything unplugged. Driver feedback support remains undocumented, not conclusively excluded.
acceptance_decision: Handoff only; hardware tests remain open.
revert_evidence: No new target communication or writes in this handoff step; USB diagnostics remain installed.
lesson: Distinguish missing documentation of readback from a definitive claim about unknown driver hardware.
next_candidate: Unpowered continuity or isolated jumper loopback for shield, then qualified one-pump test.

hypothesis: A known open control followed by a D3-S to D4-S jumper can verify shield signal paths bidirectionally.
command: arduino-cli compile; upload --verify; serial HELP BASELINE TEST at 115200
result: Upload verified; no-jumper baseline and open-circuit control match expectations. Await jumper.
acceptance_decision: Retain diagnostic; do not claim shield pass before jumper-dependent result.
revert_evidence: Previous diagnostic HEX retained; serial closed; both tested pins inputs after command.
lesson: Open-circuit negative control distinguishes real jumper loopback from existing shorts or test artifacts.
next_candidate: Operator connects D3 S to D4 S with USB removed, reconnects USB; run TEST.

hypothesis: A shield-top D3-S to D4-S jumper allows digital signals to traverse both shield signal paths.
command: Confirm same UNO USB identity; serial BASELINE and TEST at 115200.
result: D3->D4 0/20 mismatches and D4->D3 0/20; prior open control failed LOW readings as expected.
acceptance_decision: D3 and D4 digital signal paths pass. Qualify D3 power path before reconnecting pump.
revert_evidence: Serial closed; both tested pins released to inputs, pullups disabled. Operator asked to remove jumper with USB disconnected.
lesson: Positive jumper result plus open negative control establishes physical connector signal path, without proving rail routing or load operation.
next_candidate: Operator measures D3 + to GND in USB-only unloaded setup and reports voltage.

hypothesis: An external-only, operator-started single D3 pulse can test seller-supported servo-style driver control without combining USB and an unqualified external rail.
command: Compile OnePumpPulse for arduino:avr:uno; no target session.
result: Compiled candidate only. Await external-only unloaded UNO power LED observation.
acceptance_decision: Prepare candidate; no driver identification or physical OFF claims.
revert_evidence: Current ShieldLoopback firmware unchanged; no new target communications or actuator commands.
lesson: External-only actuation is a candidate way to avoid unresolved USB/external backfeed; establish that adapter powers UNO first.
next_candidate: User reports UNO ON LED with external 5V only, unloaded shield, no jumpers.

hypothesis: The kit adapter can power UNO through the shield, permitting a USB-disconnected pump test.
command: Operator external-only unloaded power-light observation; no target commands.
result: Operator corrected earlier reply: bottom UNO green power light DOES light with adapter connected and USB unplugged.
acceptance_decision: Proceed to unloaded USB-only firmware upload after operator ready; retain voltage/routing uncertainty.
revert_evidence: No target communications or writes in this step; ShieldLoopback remains installed.
lesson: Use explicit latest correction; power LED supports board power but does not measure rail voltage or load capacity.
next_candidate: Operator removes external supply, connects USB, confirms all driver plugs/jumpers disconnected; then upload OnePumpPulse.

hypothesis: The manually commanded bench firmware can be installed and identified without sending actuator commands.
command: User explicitly instructed upload; confirm USB serial; compile BedBenchTest; upload --verify; serial STATUS only.
result: Upload verified, expected firmware startup and STATUS: pin=-1 armed=0 running=0. No ARM or RUN command.
acceptance_decision: Firmware installation complete; actual pump response and power routing remain open.
revert_evidence: Prior diagnostic HEX files preserved; serial closed; manual firmware idle with inputs.
lesson: Perform explicitly requested nonactuating upload promptly; explain power-routing uncertainty separately from software readiness.
next_candidate: Whole shield power routing photo and one D3 pump connection while unpowered, before external-plus-USB actuation.

hypothesis: Unmodified StandardFirmata can replace the custom serial firmware for standard computer control.
command: Compile upstream Firmata 2.5.9 StandardFirmata; same-identity UNO upload --verify; query-only binary protocol checks at 57600.
result: Upload verified; firmware StandardFirmata.ino, protocol 2.5, capabilities, mapping and selected pin states received. Initial short-wait version queries missed startup; 6-second wait yielded startup and direct query responses. Serial closed.
acceptance_decision: StandardFirmata is current firmware; old STATUS monitor stopped.
revert_evidence: .arduino/evidence/build/2026-11-15_BedBenchTest-uploaded.hex retained.
lesson: Account for standard Firmata boot/version blink before querying; pin state is not a voltage measurement.
next_candidate: Use standard Firmata; resolve external supply routing before powered pump acceptance.

hypothesis: B1 driver at D3 may accept seller-supported servo angle 0/180 stop/run commands.
command: StandardFirmata same-board preflight; D3 servo config; 0, 180 for host-timed 505.49 ms, then 0; query D3.
result: Commands sent; Firmata reports D3 servo mode and stored 0. Physical start/stop pending operator.
acceptance_decision: Await operator observation before accepting or repeating.
revert_evidence: Proposed OFF=0 sent, firmware remains StandardFirmata, serial held open temporarily; physical cutoff requires both USB and adapter removal.
lesson: Host command/state evidence is not physical pump evidence.
next_candidate: Operator reports which pump moved and whether it stopped.

hypothesis: Reconnecting USB restores Firmata control for the authorized three-second B1/D3 test.
command: bench_pulse.py --pulse; same board/firmware preflight; D3 servo 0,180 for three seconds,0; pin-state query
result: USB open and queries passed; ON and OFF sent 3001.45 ms apart; D3 reported servo/stored 0; physical result pending.
acceptance_decision: Command test completed; await physical observation.
revert_evidence: Candidate OFF sent and stored 0 read back; automatic repeat disabled; physical cutoff adapter and USB if needed.
lesson: USB reconnection restored port opening; prior failure cause not conclusively identified.
next_candidate: Observe B1 start and stop, then identify open inlet/outlet.

hypothesis: Authorized B1/D3 servo pulse may start the connected pump.
command: Operator observation after three-second Firmata pulse; no new actuator command.
result: Operator reports nothing happened; no physical pump response.
acceptance_decision: Pump operation not demonstrated; do not repeat unchanged test.
revert_evidence: Previous candidate OFF sent and stored 0 read back; no further ON commands.
lesson: Firmware readback is not pump operation.
next_candidate: Confirm present external 5 V adapter connection and mains power after USB reconnect.

hypothesis: A user-requested ten-second repeat may make B1 response observable.
command: bench_pulse.py --pulse; duration changed to 10 seconds; D3 only
result: Same board/firmware verified; ON and OFF sent 10002.37 ms apart; afterward D3 servo/stored 0.
acceptance_decision: Command sequence complete; physical result awaits operator.
revert_evidence: Candidate OFF sent and read back; no further ON commands.
lesson: User confirms no wiring or power change.
next_candidate: Operator observes B1 start/stop.

hypothesis: Missing pump response could result from ON not reaching firmware or a reset during ON.
command: Inspect host/Firmata/Servo code; add active-state sampling; repeat bounded D3 pulse under ongoing test authorization.
result: Five active readbacks mode4/value180; after OFF mode4/value0. No observed reset or serial failure. No encoding discrepancy found. Physical pulse signal and driver supply unmeasured; actual latest pump response pending.

gate_results.driver_power: adapter presence operator confirmed; connector voltage unmeasured

acceptance_decision: Command delivery demonstrated; pump failure cause remains unresolved downstream of firmware command state.
revert_evidence: Candidate OFF sent and read back; no repeat ON scheduled; unchanged Firmata image.
lesson: Readback after OFF explains zero; active readbacks establish the ON command was accepted.
next_candidate: Current top-down upper shield and B1 driver photo to resolve power rail and plug orientation.

hypothesis: The failure might lie in host encoding, installed image identity, Firmata-to-Servo handling, or missing observable driver telemetry.
command: Query-only live audit; avrdude flash verify with -n; offline exact-HEX simulation; compile and verified diagnostic upload with operator-confirmed external adapter disconnected; live status query.
result: 39/39 queries passed; all 13184 stock flash bytes matched retained HEX; stock simulation generated nominal 544/2400us pulses. Diagnostic build 14620 flash/1136 static RAM passed normal and stuck-low input fault simulations, with invalid-key and duplicate-probe rejection. Diagnostic upload verified and live status replied. No new pump ON command.
acceptance_decision: Software path narrowed; driver-level command receipt and physical pump operation remain open.
revert_evidence: Unmodified StandardFirmata HEX retained. Current diagnostic firmware has no boot-triggered probe. Serial closed after status.
lesson: A diagnostic MCU-pad sample can test actual output logic without extra wires, but cannot identify an unknown driver or establish its supply/output voltage.
next_candidate: Finish passive pad capture, then operator-led adapter reconnection/readiness for one D3 500ms diagnostic request.

hypothesis: Does real D3 emit the proposed Servo command while the connected B1 fails to start?
command: diagnostic_probe.py --pulse-seconds 10, user requested 10 seconds after adapter reconnection/readiness
result: Five real PIND captures show nominal 2.4ms ON pulses at 50Hz; OFF captures nominal 544us. Operator reports no pump response.
acceptance_decision: The MCU emits a logic pulse train; physical driver response remains unproven.
revert_evidence: Candidate OFF sent, pad recaptured at nominal 544us; serial closed. This is not proof of physical OFF.
lesson: The missing response is downstream of real MCU pad switching or due to an incompatible waveform, not merely missing Firmata command state.
next_candidate: Same D3/10s test changing only endpoints to1000/2000us, with pad captures.

hypothesis: An RC-like 1000/2000us range could be accepted by the unidentified B1 driver when seller-derived 544/2400us was ineffective.
command: Completed diagnostic_probe.py --pulse-seconds 10 --servo-range rc; subsequent user pause and handoff request; no new hardware access.
result: Measured real PIND ON highs 1980–2028us and candidate OFF highs 984–1024us, period near20ms. Host interval10002.72ms. Driver feedback absent. Separate unambiguous physical response for this range not obtained; user says overall nothing is working.
acceptance_decision: Do not claim pump operation or a driver log. Package evidence; no further tests during pause.
revert_evidence: Candidate OFF sent and D3 servo/stored0 read back; serial closed. Stock rollback HEX retained.
lesson: Known waveform generation cannot substitute for an identified receiver, driver supply/output measurements or observed pump operation.
next_candidate: After user resumes, obtain one discriminating driver-level measurement or exact driver identification.
